source.dataset: NOAA ENC (public domain), band 5 cells US5SEA*, object M_SDAT with VERDAT 24, INFORM 'Referenced to Low Water of the Lakes which is 20 feet \ 6.1 metres above Mean Lower Low Water'
source.method: union of every M_SDAT VERDAT 24 area of the cells below (the water east of the Hiram M. Chittenden Locks where soundings are on the lakes' low water); split by a 0.0001 degree strip at longitude -122.305 across the Montlake Cut (Salmon Bay, the ship canal, Lake Union and Portage Bay are Lake Union; Union Bay and east are Lake Washington); simplified (shapely, preserve_topology) at 0.000005 degrees (about 0.5 m), coordinates rounded to 0.000001 degrees; holes under 100,000 square meters (piers, floats, small islands) filled, so only Mercer Island remains a hole
